title: 实现公益浏览器直连数据客户端
description: 新增前端公益数据 helper，直接请求姬长信 API，完成规范化、有限重试、去重、真实缓存和无数据不可展示状态。
acceptance_criteria: WHEN public-good helper refreshes THEN it requests GET https://api.isoyu.com/gy/api.php from the browser path and not project Worker /public-good; WHEN collecting records THEN it performs at most 8 attempts, dedupes by id, targets 5 valid items, uses about 6500ms timeout, about 180ms pause, and stops after 2 consecutive failures; WHEN normalizing records THEN id,name,child_pic are required by default, https detail URLs are validated, text is trimmed/limited, and raw third-party JSON is not passed to components; WHEN cache is written THEN only real validated API data is stored with version, savedAt, expiresAt, items, and default 6h TTL; WHEN refresh fails THEN historical real cache is returned if present and otherwise a not-displayable result is returned; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:38; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:47; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:52; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:56
review_initial_requirements: Write tests around injected fetch/storage/time before wiring the component; keep all request constants centralized and documented in code.
review_regression_requirements: Verify direct source URL, no Worker dependency, max attempt count, timeout behavior, dedupe, validation, cache TTL, stale real cache fallback, and no-cache not-displayable state.

title: 断开公益前台假兜底与 Worker 主路径
description: 调整前台公益消费路径，停止把 Worker /public-good 和本地 fallback batch 作为公开页正常数据来源。
acceptance_criteria: WHEN homepage public-good code loads THEN it consumes the browser direct-fetch helper from ISSUE-01 instead of app getPublicGood Worker request; WHEN direct fetch/cache has no displayable result THEN no Worker fallback, documented sample, getPublicGoodFallbackBatch, fallbackPublicGoodItems, or generic placeholder person enters the public UI; WHEN Worker /public-good remains in the codebase THEN it is not a public-page success criterion and is only diagnostic, fixture, or compatibility code; WHEN reviewing the diff THEN D1 schema, Worker auth, site CRUD architecture, and public-good CMS/statistics are not added or redesigned; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:43; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:61; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:17
review_initial_requirements: Search existing public-good callers and fallback exports before editing; preserve unrelated Worker and site CRUD behavior.
review_regression_requirements: Verify no public page dependency on /public-good, no fake/sample fallback rendered in normal UI, and no unrelated backend architecture or CMS/statistics changes.

title: 改造公益告示牌组件
description: 把公益模块改为真实数据驱动的公共告示牌，展示 5 个头像入口和 1 个详情牌，并在无真实数据时完全隐藏。
acceptance_criteria: WHEN real API data or historical real cache contains displayable records THEN the public-good section appears after the first viewport and before the portfolio list; WHEN rendered THEN it reads as a public notice board rather than an ad slot and does not mention donating a portfolio exposure slot; WHEN records are available THEN exactly up to 5 avatar entries and one selected detail board are visible with photo,name,status or sex,birth time,lost time,lost place,feature summary,and detail link; WHEN used on mobile THEN click switches selected records without relying on hover; WHEN image loading fails THEN a no-image placeholder may appear but person data is not fabricated; WHEN there is no real data and no historical real cache THEN the module renders nothing and leaves no blank block or fake no-data notice board; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:101; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:104; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:106
review_initial_requirements: Design the component around explicit displayable/hidden states from the helper; keep mobile click interaction first-class.
review_regression_requirements: Verify 5-entry layout, selected detail switching, no hover dependency on mobile, hidden no-cache state, no fake data, and location between hero and portfolio list.

title: 强化公开页 Animal Island 页面壳
description: 把公开首页从黑线框网格 demo 感改为小岛视觉系统，包含品牌、Cursor、字体、自然背景、纸质色、标题和动效。
acceptance_criteria: WHEN the public homepage first viewport loads THEN the largest brand signal reads 小茄的网站小岛 and the page does not read as a generic monitoring/demo dashboard; WHEN the page shell renders THEN Cursor wraps the public experience, Nunito + Noto Sans SC or equivalent bundled Animal Island font stack is used, natural/leaf background replaces the hard black grid, warm paper content colors and warm brown text dominate, and current #1f2523 hard-line styling is no longer the main visual; WHEN section headings and controls render THEN Animal Island Title/ribbon or equivalent, Card pattern, Tag, Button, Footer/natural decoration, and 2-3 intentional soft motions are present without cluttering the hero; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:66; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:93; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:98
review_initial_requirements: Inspect upstream animal-island-ui references before styling; preserve existing content hierarchy while replacing the page-level visual language.
review_regression_requirements: Verify brand spelling, cursor, font, background, warm palette, non-dashboard hero, natural decoration, and motion on desktop and mobile.

title: 统一作品列表小岛窗口视觉
description: 保留 live iframe 作品预览能力，同时让作品卡片从监控卡片转为温暖纸质的小岛作品窗口。
acceptance_criteria: WHEN portfolio cards render THEN live iframe remains the core preview and still lazy-loads/links to real websites as before; WHEN cards are viewed THEN hard black borders, heavy shadows, and engineering demo styling are reduced in favor of warm paper panels, rounded edges, brown text, soft hover lift, and Animal Island-like tags/buttons; WHEN status indicators render THEN they remain available but have lower visual priority than title, description, tags, and visit/open actions; WHEN user actions are used THEN visit website, status viewing, and detail/open actions remain clear and reachable; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:109; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:111
review_initial_requirements: Avoid redesigning the live iframe behavior while changing surrounding visual treatment.
review_regression_requirements: Verify iframe previews are preserved, links still work, status remains visible, and card visual language matches the homepage/public-good module.

title: 后台轻量一致化为岛务管理所
description: 在不重构 CRUD 的前提下，让后台登录、表单、列表和确认交互轻量接近 Animal Island 风格。
acceptance_criteria: WHEN admin is logged out THEN the single-admin login-only behavior is preserved; WHEN logged in THEN site list, edit panel, create, update, delete, and logout flows still use existing Worker CRUD and D1 paths; WHEN admin UI renders THEN it uses Animal Island-like font, warm paper background, rounded panels, brown text, and Input/Button/Tag/Card-like styling for login, inputs, save, cancel, delete, and status labels; WHEN delete confirmation is implemented THEN animal-island-ui Modal is preferred unless it causes excessive coupling, in which case a local same-style confirmation panel is acceptable; WHEN viewed on mobile THEN fields, buttons, and error messages do not overflow or overlap; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:116; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:118; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:119
review_initial_requirements: Keep admin efficiency and existing data paths ahead of decoration; do not introduce multi-user admin scope.
review_regression_requirements: Verify login gate, CRUD flows, visual consistency, delete confirmation, no CMS/multi-user redesign, and mobile no-overflow behavior.

title: 补充自动化验证覆盖
description: 为公益 helper、无假兜底路径和后台保留行为补充自动化验证，并运行指定短生命周期验证命令。
acceptance_criteria: WHEN public-good helper tests run THEN they cover successful API normalization, max 5 collection, id dedupe, real-only cache write, failed API reading historical real cache, failed API with no cache returning not-displayable, and document/local fake fallback not entering the normal render path; WHEN project validation runs THEN npm run lint, npm run build, and npm run test:admin are executed or any inability is recorded with validation_limited and risk; WHEN admin tests run THEN existing admin production path coverage remains valid; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:123; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:131
review_initial_requirements: Prefer deterministic injected fetch/storage tests for external API behavior; do not require live API success for unit coverage.
review_regression_requirements: Verify all listed validation commands and public-good helper cases are represented in test evidence, and limitations are not overstated as passing.

title: 完成浏览器与生产路径验收
description: 在不启动新开发服务器的前提下，使用用户已有 localhost:3000 做桌面和移动端验收，确认数据真实性、视觉风格和核心路径。
acceptance_criteria: WHEN browser validation is needed THEN use the user's already-running http://localhost:3000 and do not run npm run dev or npm run dev:all; WHEN localhost:3000 is unavailable THEN report local service unavailable and do not restart it; WHEN desktop and mobile are checked THEN first viewport clearly reads 小茄的网站小岛, Animal Island cursor/background/paper/ribbon/notice-board/soft motion are visible, public-good shows 5 records only when real data or historical real cache exists, public-good hides when no real data and no real cache exist, portfolio cards still open real sites, admin can login/edit/save/delete, and there is no obvious overlap, compressed buttons, horizontal scroll, or new console error; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:22; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:133; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:140; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-09-public-good-direct-fetch-animal-island-phase-5b-design.md:145
review_initial_requirements: Coordinate with the user-owned local server; never treat starting a new dev server as part of this issue.
review_regression_requirements: Verify desktop/mobile screenshots or browser observations for all success criteria, including the no-cache hidden state and no fake data state.
